Hope you’re well. FinServCo is completing a third-party assessment for our payments product and we need two things from Redwood to close the compliance gap this quarter:

1) A copy of your Incident Response Plan (IRP) and an excerpt of the operational runbook that covers detection->engagement->escalation (we only need the procedural steps, you can redact internal owner names).
2) Completed SIG questionnaire export and CAIQ responses for our vendor portal.

Can you provide these artifacts via an encrypted transfer or secure link by EOD Friday (2026-08-07)? If there are any sensitive attachments that need bespoke handling (e.g., full forensic logs), please flag and we can arrange an encrypted SFTP or share a temporary credentials window.

Also helpful to know: a single point of contact for any follow-ups and an availability window for a quick 15-minute call to walk us through the runbook excerpt.
